learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn how to share things equally and understand parts of a whole using super cool fractions!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A fraction is just a piece of a whole! If you slice a delicious pizza into 4 equal parts and eat 1, you just ate 1/4 of the pizza. Yum!
The top number is the numerator and shows how many parts we have. The bottom number is the denominator and shows how many equal parts make the whole object.
Sometimes different fractions mean the exact same amount! Eating 1/2 of a cake is the exact same as eating 2/4 of the same cake. They are equal partners!

fun_activity.title: 🍫 Chocolate Sharing Math
fun_activity.instructions: Take a real chocolate bar and count all its pieces. Share exactly half of it with your sibling or friend, and write down the fraction you both get!

quick_recap: ⭐ A fraction shows a part of a whole thing.
⭐ The top number is the numerator and the bottom is the denominator.
⭐ Equal fractions are called equivalent fractions!
